text_block_list.name: Mochifiend Gummy
text_block_list.text:
You were able to prevail over them all?!
Then I must acknowledge your strength!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボンノウヲ、
スベテ、
ウチクダクカ……！
ココマデトハナ……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Easy peasy!
Hope you're ready to give it up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どーだどーだ！　
まいったかー！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
We won't lose. We [[can't]] lose.
Not to impure desires, or to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボンノウなんかに、
わたしたちは負けません。
そして……
あなたにも！

text_block_list.name: Mochifiend Gummy
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Then allow me to crush you myself!
Prepare yourselves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コウナッタラ、
ジキジキニ、
ツブシテヤル……！！
カクゴシロォォォォ……！！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes!
Don't hold back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
来る……！
みんな、
全力でいくよ！
